headline.title: 8 Gemini tips for organizing your space (and life)
headline.summary: The article provides eight practical tips for utilizing Gemini to enhance organization in both physical spaces and daily life. It includes strategies for managing tasks, documents, and communication effectively through the platform.

articles.title: Three reasons why DeepSeek’s new model matters
articles.summary: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek has unveiled a preview of its new flagship model, V4, which features enhanced capabilities for processing longer prompts more efficiently. The model remains open source, continuing the company's commitment to accessibility in AI development.

articles.title: M-CARE: Standardized Clinical Case Reporting for AI Model Behavioral Disorders, with a 20-Case Atlas and Experimental Validation
articles.summary: The article introduces M-CARE, a standardized clinical case reporting framework designed for evaluating AI model behavioral disorders, modeled after human medical practices. It includes a comprehensive report format, a diagnostic assessment system, and a classification of AI behavioral conditions, supported by 20 case studies from various observational and experimental sources.

articles.title: Planetary Exploration 3.0: A Roadmap for Software-Defined, Radically Adaptive Space Systems
articles.summary: The article discusses a proposed roadmap for advancing planetary exploration through the development of software-defined, adaptive space systems, moving beyond the current incremental approach exemplified by NASA's Mars missions. It emphasizes the need to explore the largely uncharted surfaces and subsurfaces of celestial bodies beyond Mars, which may provide critical insights into planetary science.

articles.title: Integrated packing, placement, scheduling, and routing of personalized production: a pharmaceutical Industry 4.0 use-case with a planar transport system
articles.summary: The article discusses the integration of packing, placement, scheduling, and routing in personalized production within the pharmaceutical industry, utilizing a planar transport system. It highlights how this innovative approach addresses inefficiencies in traditional manufacturing by allowing independent movers to operate on a tile-based planar grid, enhancing logistics and production operations.

articles.title: AGNT2: Autonomous Agent Economies on Interaction-Optimized Layer 2 Infrastructure
articles.summary: The article discusses AGNT2, a proposed Layer 2 blockchain infrastructure designed to optimize interactions for autonomous AI agents rather than human-initiated transactions. It highlights the limitations of current Layer 2 solutions in handling high-frequency, semantically rich service invocations among untrusting entities and suggests improvements for identity, escrow, and session state management.

articles.title: The First Challenge on Remote Sensing Infrared Image Super-Resolution at NTIRE 2026: Benchmark Results and Method Overview
articles.summary: The NTIRE 2026 Remote Sensing Infrared Image Super-Resolution Challenge focuses on enhancing low-resolution infrared images to high-resolution outputs using a x4 scaling factor. The challenge aims to foster the development of advanced models for improving infrared image quality in remote sensing applications.

articles.title: mcdok at SemEval-2026 Task 13: Finetuning LLMs for Detection of Machine-Generated Code
articles.summary: The article discusses the SemEval-2026 Task 13, which focuses on the detection of machine-generated code across multiple programming languages, addressing both binary detection and source attribution. The task includes subtasks for identifying different generator LLM families and detecting hybrid code co-generated by humans and machines, as well as adversarially modified code.

articles.title: Geometric Monomial (GEM): a family of rational 2N-differentiable activation functions
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced a new family of activation functions called Geometric Monomial (GEM), which are $C^{2N}$-smooth and designed to improve optimization in deep neural networks. These functions, characterized by a log-logistic cumulative distribution function, aim to address the limitations of the widely used Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) by enhancing gradient-based optimization.

articles.title: AgencyBench: Benchmarking the Frontiers of Autonomous Agents in 1M-Token Real-World Contexts
articles.summary: The article discusses AgencyBench, a new benchmarking framework designed to evaluate autonomous agents in large language models (LLMs) within real-world contexts involving one million tokens. It addresses the limitations of current benchmarks that focus on single capabilities and highlights the need for scalable evaluation methods that do not rely on human feedback.

articles.title: Geo-R1: Improving Few-Shot Geospatial Referring Expression Understanding with Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
articles.summary: The article introduces Geo-R1, a novel approach to enhance few-shot geospatial referring expression understanding through reinforcement fine-tuning. This method aims to improve performance in data-scarce scenarios by focusing on reasoning over complex object-context relationships in remote sensing applications.

articles.title: Federated Learning for Surgical Vision in Appendicitis Classification: Results of the FedSurg EndoVis 2024 Challenge
articles.summary: The FedSurg Challenge is introduced as the first international benchmarking initiative focused on applying Federated Learning (FL) to surgical vision, specifically for classifying appendicitis using complex surgical video data. This initiative addresses the challenge of utilizing multi-institutional data while maintaining patient privacy, marking a significant step in the development of generalizable surgical AI.
